text:
Adverse event summary narrative:

For the 2026-Q1 reporting period, the 30-day all-cause readmission rate measure (READM-30) recorded 188 readmissions among a denominator of 1325, with 43 exclusions. The reported rate was 14.66 percent. The event dates listed for this measure were 2026-01-24, 2026-04-18, 2026-06-19, 2026-07-17, and 2026-11-21.

For the 2026-Q2 reporting period, the hospital-acquired pressure injury rate measure (HAPI-02) recorded 41 events among a denominator of 210, with 15 exclusions. The reported rate was 21.03 percent. The event dates listed for this measure were 2026-01-24, 2026-07-04, 2026-07-19, 2026-09-18, and 2026-11-09.

For the 2026-Q1 reporting period, the sepsis bundle compliance within 3 hours measure (SEP-B1) recorded 115 compliant cases among a denominator of 535, with 41 exclusions. The reported rate was 23.28 percent. The event dates listed for this measure were 2026-02-14, 2026-04-08, 2026-08-18, 2026-09-28, and 2026-10-19.

Across the source records, the reported adverse event and quality-related measures include all-cause readmissions, hospital-acquired pressure injuries, and sepsis bundle compliance within 3 hours. The records provide measure identifiers, measure names, reporting periods, numerators, denominators, exclusions, rates, units, and associated event dates. No additional patient-level details, harm severity classifications, locations of care, contributing factors, or remediation actions were included in the structured records provided.
